_comment: INTENT RECORD and PARTIAL desk bytes for the Board P r3 20 V / 5 A unit (dec PWR-D3 = D3-A, PWR-D5 = D5-1). Not an image to program: status BLOCKED. Never written to any part or read back.
status: BLOCKED (TDISPAR0V position unavailable; capability-mismatch behaviour unknown)

intent.PDO2: 20.00 V, 5.00 A; needs a 5 A e-marked cable and a source offering 20 V / 5 A
intent.TDISPAR0V: >= 13 so the 2 kOhm VBUS_VS_DISCH feed reaches vSafe0V (default 9 gives >= 630 ms, too short)
intent.accept_or_refuse: VBUS_OUT only on a 20 V contract at 5 A; any lower-current 20 V contract must leave Q1 off (no degraded mode)

blocked.reason: No retained field map gives its sector/byte/bit (third-party map has no discharge-time field; no ST NVM map document retained). Needed: an ST-authored NVM map or the ST GUI export format.

Retained evidence does not state whether VBUS_EN_SNK asserts after a PDO2 request granted below 5 A or with the capability-mismatch bit set. Until a primary ST statement or a bench test closes it, accept-or-refuse cannot rely on the NVM alone. Board-side alternative: refuse through the B20 VIN UV and current limits, which do not detect a 3 A contract.

base_and_field_map: scripts/pcb/board-p15/nvm-image.py (BASE, decode, setbits; THIRD_PARTY map, Rev 7 default cross-check PASS)
